chunks: every praiser has on whom he praises the right of reward and recompense, or a known [grant] from bounty.
And I have hoped from You a sign/guide to the treasures of Mercy and the stores of forgiveness.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of praising God in Shia supplications according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In the chapter of Al-Ashbaah, Imam Ali (AS) articulates a profound theological principle where human praise acts as a catalyst for divine generosity, reflecting the Shia concept of God's boundless mercy responding to human recognition. This supplication highlights the spiritual mechanism by which acknowledging God's attributes serves as a 'proof' or 'sign' to access the hidden treasures of forgiveness, emphasizing the reciprocal nature of the Creator-creature relationship.

en.sayed-ali-raza: every praiser has on whom he praises the right of reward and recompense.
Certainly, I have turned to Thee with my eye at the treasures of Thy Mercy and stores of forgiveness.
